item.title: 12-Year-Old Linux NFS Vulnerability Lets Remote Attackers Gain Root
item.description:
12-Year-Old Linux NFS Vulnerability Lets Remote Attackers Gain Root

A 12‑year‑old critical vulnerability in the Linux kernel’s NFS server, CVE‑2026‑99362, lets remote attackers gain root privileges.

🔍 Overview

  • The flaw, dubbed NFS2ROOT by OpenSec, is a heap buffer overflow in the nfsd server.
  • Remote attackers can send crafted requests that write beyond an allocated buffer.
  • Successful exploitation corrupts kernel memory and grants root access on exposed Linux servers.

🧩 How it Works

  • An attacker sends malicious NFSv4.1 requests causing the server to write past a buffer.
  • This allows reading of kernel memory, bypassing KASLR.
  • A callback is placed in a released memory area that executes a command.
  • When the connection closes, the kernel runs the embedded command with root privileges.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Vulnerability exists since Linux kernel 3.16 (March 2014).
  • Affects kernels older than 6.12.117, 6.18.61, 7.3.2, or 7.4‑rc1 when nfsd (v4.1 or 4.2) is loaded and TCP port 2049 is reachable over the Internet.
  • No user interaction required; low‑complexity attack.

🚀 Availability

  • ANSSI’s Jérémy Jean submitted a fix in August; the patch was shared with NFSD maintainers in late September.

💡 Why it Matters

  • No wild exploitation reports yet, but the flaw can give attackers full control.
  • Apply the latest kernel security updates immediately and reboot.
  • If patching isn’t possible, restrict TCP port 2049 to trusted clients or disable nfs-server in /etc/nfs.conf.
  • Kernel hardening does not remove the overflow; patch every host.
  • Monitor for signs such as kernel warnings from nfsd4_check_resp_size, shells spawned by kernel workers, bursts of short NFSv4.1 sessions, and kernel oopses with nfsd4_* or svc_* frames.

📚 Related Flaws

  • Other privilege escalation bugs disclosed this year include RefluXFS, CIFSwitch, Dirty Frag, Fragnesia, PinTheft, Copy Fail, Pack2TheRoot, and DirtyDecrypt/DirtyCBC.

#Linux #NFS #KernelSecurity #CVE202699362 #PrivilegeEscalation #CyberSecurity

Source: New NFS2ROOT Linux flaw can let attackers gain root privileges

item.title: Signal Adds Protections Blocking AI Assistant Screen Access on iOS and Android
item.description:
Signal Adds Protections Blocking AI Assistant Screen Access on iOS and Android

Signal has announced new protections that block screenshots on iOS 27 and prevent AI assistants from capturing conversations on supported Android devices. These measures are designed to stop built-in AI assistants, such as Siri and Gemini, from accessing private conversation content while performing tasks for users.

🔍 Overview

The announcement follows Signal’s introduction of a feature in May 2025 that blocked Microsoft’s Recall screenshot-capturing feature on Windows 11. Signal’s president, Meredith Whittaker, stated that the company is now taking similar measures to restrict agentic systems built into iOS 17 and on Android versions where an AI assistant attempting to read the Signal screen can be detected.

Signal engineers spent months investigating how AI systems access app data. They designed targeted protections to block all extraction pathways, which were verified through reverse engineering. The protections specifically target OS-level features like Siri’s Onscreen Awareness and Google’s Gemini Intelligence, which can otherwise capture chat content as it appears on the screen.

⚙️ Key Details

The new protections operate differently across platforms:

  • iOS: The protection blocks screenshots entirely. This includes preventing users from taking screenshots of Signal conversations for legitimate purposes. On the iOS app, users can verify that “Block Siri AI” is enabled by navigating to Settings > App Security.
  • Android: Signal automatically enables Screen Security when it detects an AI assistant attempting to access the screen.
  • macOS: Signal is currently unable to provide screenshot-blocking protection for macOS. For macOS 27 users, Signal recommends adding the app to the Excluded Apps list under System Settings > Siri to prevent proactive access to message content.

Signal notes that the protections are automatically activated when possible, though specific app version numbers were not provided.

💡 Why it Matters

Signal warns that AI agents embedded deep in operating systems pose an “existential threat” because they can access conversation data through methods beyond simple screen reading. Whittaker notes that these vulnerabilities leave apps with limited options for protecting users and expose sensitive private data belonging to all conversation participants.

In response, Signal is calling on Apple, Google, and Microsoft to provide detailed documentation disclosing all potential access mechanisms. The company urges these operating system vendors to give developers a clear way to opt out of AI access across screens, files, notifications, and APIs.

#Signal #Privacy #AIAgents #Security #iOS #Android

Source: Signal to block Siri, Gemini AI from capturing chats on iOS, Android

item.title: Microsoft releases Windows 11 KB5132057 November optional cumulative update
item.description:
Microsoft releases Windows 11 KB5132057 November optional cumulative update

Microsoft released the KB5132057 November optional cumulative update for Windows 11 versions 25H2 and 26H2, bringing 28 changes including improvements to Windows Search, Windows Hello, and the Run dialog. This preview update allows IT administrators to test improvements, bug fixes, and new features before the next Patch Tuesday release, and it will be the final non-security preview update released this year as operations wind down for the Western holidays.

🔍 Overview

KB5132057 is an optional non-security preview update that provides only quality improvements rather than security fixes. Installing this update will upgrade Windows 11 26H2 and 25H2 devices to builds 26300.10075 and 26200.10075, respectively. Microsoft also noted that a limited number of consumer and business devices might experience one additional restart during installation after a Secure Boot certificate update is applied.

⚙️ Key features and changes

  • Windows Search: Features a new WinUI 3-based Search Box experience that removes promotional content from web results for better resource efficiency and streamlined design. Search from This PC in File Explorer is now indexer-based, and inline actions let users complete common tasks directly from Windows Search.
  • Windows Hello: Includes improved facial recognition enabling sign-in in dark rooms after turning on the “Automatically adjust screen brightness during face recognition” setting.
  • Run Dialog: Adds the new Run dialog with a refreshed design and an almost instant time-to-show of 94 ms.
  • Accessibility: Users can now turn off accidentally triggered keyboard shortcuts for Sticky Keys, Filter Keys, or Toggle Keys directly from the appearing prompt.
  • Enterprise and Security: Web sign-in is now supported on Microsoft Entra hybrid-joined devices, allowing password-free lock screen sign-in via FIDO2 keys, phone passkeys, or Temporary Access Pass.
  • Bug Fixes: Resolves an issue where the File History restore interface might not find backups when a drive is selected as the backup location.
Feature / Component Description
Windows Search Box Built on WinUI 3, removes promotional web content for streamlined design.
Inline Actions Complete tasks like turning on dark mode/Bluetooth, adjusting brightness, or managing open windows directly from search.
Phone Link Integration Call or text contacts, and use “Find my phone” and “Do Not Disturb” actions if an Android phone is connected.
Windows Hello Improved facial recognition for signing into accounts in dark rooms.

🚀 Availability

  • Users can install the update by opening Windows Settings, clicking Windows Update, and clicking ‘Check for Updates’.
  • Because it is an optional update, users must click the “Download and install” link unless they have the “Get the latest updates as soon as they’re available” option enabled.
  • The preview update can also be manually downloaded and installed from the Microsoft Update Catalog.

#Windows11 #Microsoft #WindowsUpdate #TechNews

Source: Windows 11 KB5132057 update released with 28 changes and fixes

item.title: Windows hotpatch update causes ERROR_ALLOTTED_SPACE_EXCEEDED error
item.description:
Windows hotpatch update causes ERROR_ALLOTTED_SPACE_EXCEEDED error

Devices that installed the November 2026 hotpatch update may experience errors when installing, launching, or running some applications. The error displayed is similar to “ERROR_ALLOTTED_SPACE_EXCEEDED (0xC0000099)”.

🧩 How it works

Current investigation suggests this issue occurs for applications that load the 32-bit Windows Installer DLL, found as msi.dll. This can happen more frequently with 32-bit applications, but can also occur for 64-bit applications under certain conditions.

⚙️ Key details

  • Affected Systems: This known issue impacts systems that have installed the hotpatch updates pushed through Windows Autopatch. It should not impact systems that have installed the standard November 2026 Patch Tuesday security updates.
  • Workaround: Users must edit the Windows Registry to increase the HotPatchTableSize.
  • Registry Procedure:
    1. Open the Windows Registry by typing “regedit” in the Start menu and selecting Registry Editor.
    2. Navigate to the HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management folder.
    3. Locate the “HotPatchTableSize” registry key, open it, and set the Value to “2000”.
    4. Close the registry editor and restart the device.
  • Warning: Microsoft advised backing up the registry and ensuring knowledge of how to restore it before modifying it.

🚀 Availability

  • Windows Autopatch History: Microsoft first announced Windows Autopatch in April 2022, stating it would be available for free to customers with a Windows 10/11 Enterprise E3 license or greater starting in July 2022.
  • Public Preview: The feature reached public preview in early June and has been generally available since July 2022.
  • Default Policy: Microsoft stated in March that it would turn on hotpatch security updates by default for all eligible Windows devices managed through the Microsoft Graph API and Microsoft Intune, after the May 2026 Windows security updates are installed.
  • Recent Fix: One month after the March announcement, Microsoft fixed a Windows Autopatch bug that caused driver updates restricted by administrative policies to deploy on some Autopatch-managed Windows devices belonging to customers in the European Union.

#Windows #Hotpatch #WindowsAutopatch #SecurityUpdates #Registry

Source: Microsoft confirms app installation, launch issues after hotpatch

item.title: ChromaLeon: Dynamic GNOME Theme Accent Colors
item.description:
ChromaLeon: Dynamic GNOME Theme Accent Colors

ChromaLeon is a GNOME extension that dynamically changes accent colors based on your wallpaper. It’s a project maintained in spare time, with support for native GNOME accent colors and seamless application across GNOME Shell and GTK apps.

🔍 Overview

  • Change your GNOME Shell and GTK accent colors dynamically based on your wallpaper.
  • Change your GNOME Shell, Adwaita, adw-gtk3, and app/folder icons accent colors dynamically based on your wallpaper.
  • ChromaLeon was created within the context of the Adwaita theme.

🧩 How it works

  • Dynamic Extraction: Automatically extracts accent colors from your current wallpaper.
  • Applies accent colors seamlessly across GNOME Shell and GTK 3.0 / 4.0 apps.
  • Theme the Shell and all your LibAdwaita and GTK3 applications with Adw-GTK3.
  • Applies the accent color to the folders.
  • Applies the accent color to some app icons.
  • Includes a wallpaper selector for user wallpapers and GNOME dynamic wallpapers.
  • Allow applying custom CSS to the shell, with support for ChromaLeon’s accent color.
  • Hot Reload for GTK4 applications with support for ChromaLeon colors (works natively for GNOME colors).
  • Syncs color variables so your sandboxed Flatpak applications match the rest of the system.

⚙️ Key details

  • ChromaLeon conflicts DIRECTLY with the User Theme extension. If you have this extension installed, please REMOVE or DISABLE it to avoid any errors.
  • If you are experiencing any issues customizing applications or GNOME Shell, please ensure you are using the Adwaita theme before opening an issue.
  • A special thanks to PakoVM for the inspiration behind the tinted style. The implementation in ChromaLeon was based on an idea from his Tint My GNOME extension.

💡 Why it matters

  • ChromaLeon is a project I maintain in my spare time. If possible, please consider making a small donation to support my work!
  • Create a shortcut in the app grid to use this extension as an app.

🚀 Availability

  • ChromaLeon is available as a GNOME extension.

#GNOME #ChromaLeon #DynamicTheme #GTK #Adwaita

Source: Fabito02/ChromaLeon

item.title: Apple Tests Daily Usage Limits for Siri AI and Apple Intelligence Features
item.description:
Apple Tests Daily Usage Limits for Siri AI and Apple Intelligence Features

Apple released betas of iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3, and macOS 27.3, using the updates to test new per-device daily usage limits for select Siri AI and Apple Intelligence features.

🧩 How it works

Basic Siri commands and requests remain free and unlimited. However, advanced features relying on cloud-based processing are subject to daily limits. There are four categories of limited usage:

  • Using Siri AI for multi-step, personal context requests
  • Image generation and editing tools
  • Automations in Shortcuts that rely on Apple Foundation Cloud and Cloud Pro Models
  • Third-party apps that use those same cloud models

Apple has not specified exactly how many times these features can be used before limits are reached, noting that limits will vary based on the task. The company plans to provide notifications when users are approaching their limit and when they have finally reached it.

⚙️ Key details

Frequent users of these features will require an iCloud Plus subscription to avoid limits. Instead of waiting until midnight for usage to reset, most existing iCloud Plus plans (excluding the 50GB option) include higher daily limits at the same price:

Plan Monthly Cost Usage Multiplier
200GB $2.99 2x
2TB $9.99 5x
6TB $29.99 10x
12TB $59.99 20x

Family members sharing an iCloud Plus subscription will have a shared usage pool that is used on a first-come, first-served basis.

#Apple #Siri #AppleIntelligence #iCloud #UsageLimits

Source: Apple is testing daily usage limits for more complex Siri AI interactions

item.title: open-computer-use expands platform support and adds macOS Locked Use
item.description:
open-computer-use expands platform support and adds macOS Locked Use

open-computer-use, an open‑source Computer Use service wrapped as MCP, has expanded its platform support and added a macOS locked‑use feature.

🔍 Overview

  • open-computer-use is an open‑source Computer Use service wrapped as MCP.
  • Inspired by OpenAI’s Codex Computer Use.
  • Built on Accessibility to create non‑intrusive CUA.

🧩 How It Works

  • Any AI agent or MCP client can run Computer Use on macOS, Linux, and Windows.
  • Gemini CLI connects through MCP to run full Computer Use actions.
  • In Codex App and Codex CLI, it matches official experience.

⚙️ Key Details

Installation

  • Install the skill directly.
  • Install for Codex.
  • Install for Claude Code.
  • Update an existing global install, including Codex install created above.
  • Manually download and install the open‑computer‑use skill.

Usage

  • Call a single Computer Use tool and print the MCP‑style JSON result.
  • Run a sequence in one process to reuse element_index state.
  • Sequence sleeps 1s between successful operations by default.

Permissions

  • On macOS, run once and grant Accessibility and Screen Recording.
  • Windows and Linux do not require this step.
  • Check permissions; onboarding opens only when missing.
  • macOS: query permission JSON without opening onboarding.

Configuration

  • ocu supports global configuration starting with version 1.0.0.
  • Default configuration file: ~/.config/ocu/config.json.

Locked Use (macOS)

  • Locked Use is now supported on macOS.
  • OCU temporarily unlocks the Mac after it has been locked so the agent can continue working.
  • Protective services such as a full‑screen shield are in place during use.
  • See the Locked Use guide for setup, installed components, and permissions.

Runtime Requirements (macOS)

Requirement Detail
macOS version 14.0 or later
Permissions Accessibility & Screen Recording
Steps Run once to grant permissions

🚀 Availability

  • Running on Linux.
  • macOS runtime requires macOS 14.0+.
  • Windows and Linux require no special permissions.

💡 Why it Matters

  • Has become one of the most useful workflows for nearly 100 % AI‑generated projects.
  • Built on open source, enabling quick setup with the harness template.
  • Offers a non‑intrusive, accessibility‑based solution for Computer Use across major OSes.

For more on the methodology behind this project, see the post at https://www.ifuryst.com/blog/2026/speedrunning-the-ai-era/

#OpenAI #ComputerUse #AIAgents #macOS #Accessibility

Source: iFurySt/open-computer-use

item.title: RTX Spark laptops combine Arm CPU, Blackwell GPU and unified memory for AI agents
item.description:
RTX Spark laptops combine Arm CPU, Blackwell GPU and unified memory for AI agents

Microsoft and Nvidia held a launch party for the first wave of RTX Spark laptops last week in San Francisco, where a new wave of AI PCs took center stage amid a packed crowd and a lively hands‑on area.

🔍 Overview

  • RTX Spark is a new class of Windows laptops that pairs an Arm‑based CPU with Nvidia’s Blackwell GPU and a unified‑memory architecture.
  • The design enables powerful AI models to run locally on a laptop, making the experience of setting up an AI agent quick and easy.

🧩 Architecture & Core Tech

  • The chips inside RTX Spark laptops are Arm‑based, instead of the traditional x64 architecture used by AMD and Intel.
  • Microsoft’s Prism emulator is used for apps that don’t have a native Arm version.
  • “Each core is different. How we translate x64 to that core needs to be highly optimized, and for RTX Spark we’ve done a lot of work to optimize for its microarchitecture.” – Peter Dawoud

⚙️ Features

  • Get Started experience: “When users get into Windows for the first time, they’ll see a new Get Started experience that will launch on an RTX Spark laptop that allows them to find the agent they want, get started with that agent, install it, and get to that agent in only two clicks,” says Peter Dawoud.
  • Agent installation: Agents can be installed and updated through the Windows Store, eliminating the need to track dependencies.
  • First‑party agents: Hermes, Perplexity, and OpenClaw are the first three officially supported agents at launch.
  • Unified memory: Microsoft’s Surface Laptop Ultra can ship with up to 128 GB of unified memory, making it possible to load huge models into memory.
  • “We made incredible investments in Unified Memory Architecture to enable you to load as much as possible into the 128GB,” says Dawoud.
  • Memory optimizations cover power, performance, battery life, and allow a game to run while rendering a video in the background.
  • Memory slider: A slider in Nvidia’s Windows app lets users manually adjust how much of the unified memory is dedicated to the GPU side. This is useful on RTX Spark laptops with 24 GB or 32 GB of memory to balance more to the GPU for particular apps and games.
  • Gaming capability: While RTX Spark laptops aren’t marketed as gaming machines, they can run the latest AAA titles. Anti‑cheat support was secured as a first step for gaming on Windows on Arm.

Supported AI Agents

Agent Status at launch
Hermes Officially supported
Perplexity Officially supported
OpenClaw Officially supported

Games with Built‑in Anti‑Cheat Support

Game Anti‑cheat support
Fortnite Supported out of the box
Marvel Rivals Supported out of the box
Arc Raiders Supported out of the box
Counter‑Strike 2 Supported out of the box
Dota 2 Supported out of the box

🚀 Availability

The first wave of RTX Spark laptops was unveiled at the San Francisco launch event. Microsoft and Nvidia are continuing to work with additional anti‑cheat providers to bring more games to the platform in the future.

💡 Why it matters

  • Combining an Arm CPU, Blackwell GPU, and up to 128 GB of unified memory lets laptops load and run large AI models locally.
  • The streamlined Windows Get Started flow reduces the steps needed to find, install, and launch an AI agent to just two clicks.
  • Unified‑memory tuning and a manual slider give users flexibility to balance performance for AI workloads and gaming on the same device.

#RTXSpark #AIagents #ArmPC #UnifiedMemory

Source: How Windows is being optimized for Nvidia’s RTX Spark laptops

item.title: Android adds Gemini‑AI‑powered enhanced protection to Google Messages
item.description:
Android adds Gemini‑AI‑powered enhanced protection to Google Messages

Android is introducing new scam defense features that aim to make it easier for users to evade mobile fraud, including bolstered protection in Google Messages and additional safeguarding tools.

🔍 Overview

  • Android is using AI to suss out scammers in Google Messages.
  • A new “enhanced protection” setting will roll out in the coming weeks and is opt‑in.

🧩 How it works

  • The enhanced protection mode taps into cloud‑based Gemini AI models to quickly evaluate a potential scammer’s intentions in conversations with an unrecognized sender.
  • “Scammers often disguise their true motives behind slow‑burn conversations,” Google said.
  • “This secure cloud analysis augments and extends our existing on‑device detection, allowing us to identify novel and sophisticated attacks, actively uncovering and stopping abusers who try to hide their tracks.”
  • User data is encrypted during this AI analysis and processed in a secure dedicated space that Google (and anyone else besides the user) can’t access.
  • The mode also uses on‑device Gemini Nano AI to inspect real‑time web signals in unfamiliar URLs before they are opened to determine if the links are malicious.

⚙️ New security features

Feature Description
Call‑forwarding block Blocks apps from enabling call forwarding and notifies the user when someone attempts to do so.
Screen‑share privacy Automatically conceals sensitive information while screen‑sharing in Chrome and Android WebView.
Enhanced protection Opt‑in mode that uses Gemini AI to assess intentions of unrecognized senders and scans URLs with Gemini Nano.

🌐 Expansion and rollout

  • The scam detection feature for chat notifications that Google introduced on Pixel phones last year is expanding to devices from Honor, Motorola, Oppo, OnePlus, Realme, Tecno, Vivo, Xiaomi, and more.
  • Google says it plans to bring it to “hundreds of millions of additional users later this year.”

#Android #AI #Security #ScamDetection

Source: Android is using AI to suss out scammers in Google Messages

item.title: Microsoft adds local file access to Copilot via Hybrid Intelligence
item.description:
Microsoft adds local file access to Copilot via Hybrid Intelligence

At the Windows and Surface event, Microsoft unveiled an upgrade to its Copilot AI system that lets the assistant read local files on a PC and act across the operating system.

🔍 Overview

Microsoft calls the new approach Hybrid Intelligence – a mix of local and cloud AI models that lets apps and tools complete tasks efficiently.

🧩 How it works

  • Hybrid Intelligence gives Copilot permission to scan folders on the Windows PC, locate files, rename them, zip them, and draft emails.
  • During the demo, Jacob Andreou, Microsoft’s EVP of Copilot, asked the Autopilot agent to help file taxes. The agent used Hybrid Intelligence to find the accountant’s needed documents, package them, and prepare a message with the zip file attached.
  • The same technology powers a refreshed Windows search experience that lets users perform quick actions directly from the search bar.

⚙️ Key features

  • Local file access – Copilot can browse the user’s folders and use the contents to carry out tasks.
  • Cross‑OS actions – The assistant can rename files, create zip archives, and send emails without leaving the AI chat.
  • Quick‑action search – The new Windows search bar includes in‑line controls such as a dark‑mode toggle, a microphone‑volume slider, and a one‑click option to send a text.

🚀 Availability

  • Features powered by Hybrid Intelligence will roll out over the “next couple months,” according to Jacob Andreou.
  • The new Windows search experience ships this fall on Windows 11 PCs, announced by Windows and Surface boss Pavan Davuluri.

#Microsoft #Copilot #HybridIntelligence #Windows11

Source: Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files

item.title: Microsoft unveils Surface Laptop Ultra with Nvidia RTX Spark and Hybrid Intelligence
item.description:
Microsoft unveils Surface Laptop Ultra with Nvidia RTX Spark and Hybrid Intelligence

Microsoft just wrapped up a big Windows and Surface‑focused keynote in San Francisco. The headline announcement was the Surface Laptop Ultra, a new laptop powered by Nvidia’s RTX Spark Arm‑based chip.

🔍 Overview

  • Surface Laptop Ultra runs on Nvidia’s RTX Spark, an Arm‑based processor that can support up to 128 GB of unified memory.
  • It ships with a 15‑inch HDR touchscreen that can reach up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness.
  • The device replaces the old proprietary Surface Connect port with a magnetic USB‑C charging connector that Microsoft calls Magnetic Connect.
  • Microsoft also announced the Surface RTX Spark Dev Box, a developer‑focused mini PC that runs the same RTX Spark platform.

🧩 How it works

  • RTX Spark chip – an Arm‑based processor designed for high‑performance creative software, gaming, and local AI tasks.
  • Hybrid Intelligence – a Windows update that lets Copilot access files stored on the PC and perform actions. In a live demo, Copilot searched folders, renamed files, zipped them, and drafted an email with the attachment.
  • Dev Box – equipped with 128 GB of unified memory, a 100‑watt thermal envelope and Nvidia Tensor cores, enabling local AI models exceeding 120 B parameters and a strong gaming capability.

⚙️ Key specifications

  • Display: 15‑inch HDR touchscreen, up to 2,000 nits peak brightness
  • Memory (base config): 24 GB RAM
  • Storage (base config): 512 GB SSD
  • Charging: Magnetic USB‑C (Magnetic Connect)
  • Trackpad: Larger surface with haptic feedback
  • Processor: Nvidia RTX Spark Arm‑based chip (up to 128 GB unified memory)
Product RAM Storage Price Release date
Surface Laptop Ultra 24 GB 512 GB $2,599 October 16
Surface RTX Spark Dev Box 128 GB unified – $5,999 (pre‑order) November (shipping)

🚀 Availability

  • Surface Laptop Ultra starts at $2,599 for the base configuration and will be available on October 16.
  • Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is available for preorder at $5,999 and is slated to ship in November.

💡 Why it matters

  • Both devices target the premium end of the laptop and PC market, offering hardware capable of running demanding creative apps, games, and on‑device AI workloads.
  • The Hybrid Intelligence integration gives Copilot the ability to act on local files, expanding the usefulness of AI within Windows.
  • The Dev Box’s developer‑optimized Windows 11 Pro setup and preinstalled tools (VS Code, Git, GitHub Copilot, WSL, Python, Node) make it a ready‑to‑use platform for AI model testing, prototyping agents, and on‑device coding assistance.

#Surface #Nvidia #AI #HybridIntelligence #Windows

item.title: Nouveau/NVK Driver Runs on NVIDIA Spark Box After Extensive Patching
item.description:
Nouveau/NVK Driver Runs on NVIDIA Spark Box After Extensive Patching

After much back and forth and hoops jumping, I can finally reveal nouveau/nvk running on a NVIDIA Spark box.

🔍 Overview

  • The open‑source nouveau/nvk driver has been demonstrated on a NVIDIA Spark platform.
  • The effort involved a large patch series and new firmware.

🛠️ What was required

  • 100 patches were prepared for the driver.
  • A new firmware was required for the hardware.
  • The author notes it “might mean it’s a wait for nova type situation” when considering upstream integration.

🚀 Availability

  • Upstreaming is still uncertain; the author is “not sure how best to upstream it all.”
  • No official release or integration status is provided beyond the demonstration.

📺 Watching the demo

  • To view the live stream of the demonstration, go to the YouTube schedule overview and hover over the paperclip to see the ‘Live Stream’ link.
  • Live streams are only available for A/V assisted tracks.
  • For a two‑way conversation during the stream, you need a Matrix account, join the Linux Plumbers Space, and find the room corresponding to the track you’re watching.

⚠️ ACPI Operation Region Conflicts (Related Kernel Insight)

  • Many people mistakenly think warnings like ACPI Warning: SystemIO range … conflicts with OpRegion … indicate a firmware bug; this is generally untrue.
  • The Advanced Configuration and Power Interface (ACPI) specification abstracts hardware details.
  • ACPI provides information as code via the ACPI Source Language (ASL), which is compiled into bytecode interpreted by the OS at runtime.
  • ASL can define Operation Regions that map to hardware registers.
  • Example: an operation region OPR1 at I/O port 0x400, 2 bytes long, with 8‑bit fields INDX and DATA.
  • ACPI methods lock access to these registers; however, a Linux driver that accesses the hardware directly has no knowledge of ACPI and can race with ACPI methods.
  • The kernel detects such conflicts and emits warnings such as: ACPI Warning: SystemIO range 0x0000000000000400-0x000000000000401 conflicts with OpRegion 0x0000000000000400-0x0000000000000401 (OPR1).
  • This warning indicates a driver is attempting to allocate I/O ports that an ACPI operation region already claims.

All statements are drawn directly from the provided evidence.

#Nouveau #NVK #NVIDIA #Linux #ACPI

Source: Kernel Planet

item.title: Open‑Source RemoveMacAI Tool Deletes Apple Intelligence Models, Frees Up Storage
item.description:
Open‑Source RemoveMacAI Tool Deletes Apple Intelligence Models, Frees Up Storage

A new open‑source command‑line utility called RemoveMacAI lets macOS users delete Apple Intelligence models and disable its bundled AI features in a single step, reclaiming roughly a dozen gigabytes of disk space.

🔧 What RemoveMacAI Does

  • ‘RemoveMacAI’ switches off Apple’s AI features, deletes its AI models, and blocks them from being downloaded again.
  • It removes the on‑disk foundation models, which the developer says take up about 12 GB of space (some users report even more).
  • The changes persist across macOS updates.
  • Dictation continues to work after removal.
  • The tool provides a removemacai revert command to re‑enable all features and allow the models to download again.
  • A removemacai status command shows the size of each individual AI model on the Mac.

“I wrote RemoveMacAI to do all of it in one go.”

📦 Storage Impact

  • Apple Intelligence models remain on disk by default, occupying about 12 GB according to the developer.
  • A user measured 35.05 GB of space labeled “Apple Intelligence” on a MacBook Air.
  • Running RemoveMacAI deletes these models, freeing the corresponding storage.

⚙️ How It Works

  1. The tool toggles off the following AI‑related features:
    • Siri
    • Writing Tools
    • Genmoji
    • Image Playground
    • The ChatGPT extension
    • All summary functions
  2. It then deletes the stored foundation models from the file system.
  3. Finally, it prevents macOS from re‑downloading the models unless the user runs removemacai revert.

📋 Feature List

Feature Action performed by RemoveMacAI
Siri Turned off
Writing Tools Turned off
Genmoji Turned off
Image Playground Turned off
ChatGPT extension Turned off
Summaries Turned off

📆 Availability

  • The utility is open‑source and was announced by its developer on Reddit.
  • It replaces the single Settings toggle that existed for disabling Apple Intelligence before it was removed in macOS 27, where the models stayed on disk and settings were split across multiple panes (including several under Screen Time).

💡 Why It Matters

  • Users who prefer not to run Apple’s on‑device AI can now remove the models entirely, reclaiming storage without losing core functionality like Dictation.
  • The tool simplifies what previously required navigating about a dozen settings across various preference panes.
  • By blocking future downloads, it ensures the storage savings remain until the user decides to restore the features.

item.title: Apple to Tighten Mac Full Disk Access Controls Amid AI Agent Risks
item.description:
Apple to Tighten Mac Full Disk Access Controls Amid AI Agent Risks

Apple has announced plans to tighten the way apps are granted Full Disk Access on macOS, citing growing risks as AI agents become more capable and autonomous. The company warned that this broad permission can expose highly sensitive data and bypasses the privacy controls normally used to protect user data.

🔍 Overview

Full Disk Access is one of the broadest permissions available in macOS. While it is intended for software like backup tools, it allows apps to reach data that is otherwise protected behind separate privacy controls. Apple reports that some developers are currently using this permission in ways that could put users at risk by exposing several types of data:

  • Personal files
  • Email messages
  • Messages
  • Browsing history
  • Sensitive data across large parts of a system

⚙️ Key Details

Apple directly linked the upcoming changes to the rise of agentic AI software. Unlike traditional apps that might need access for a single function, AI agents can carry out tasks across multiple apps, files, and services.

Feature Description
Permission Level One of the broadest in macOS; bypasses standard privacy controls.
Original Intent Designed for utilities such as backup software.
Current Concern AI agents may expose significantly more personal info than traditional apps.
Privacy Stance Positioned as a central part of Apple’s on-device and cloud-based AI processing.

🧩 How it Works

The company intends to introduce additional controls that require more explicit user action before an app can receive Full Disk Access. The goal of these protections is to ensure users clearly understand the risks involved and make a deliberate, informed decision before granting such broad access to their data.

🚀 Availability

Apple has not announced exactly what the new Full Disk Access controls will look like or when they will arrive. The company stated only that the additional protections will be introduced going forward as it continues to expand artificial intelligence across the Mac through Apple Intelligence and Siri AI.

#Apple #macOS #AIAgents #Privacy #Cybersecurity

Source: Apple plans tougher Mac Full Disk Access controls as AI agents expand

item.title: Rabbit Launches Standalone OS3 Agentic Operating System
item.description:
Rabbit Launches Standalone OS3 Agentic Operating System

Rabbit is releasing a standalone AI agent called OS3, an “agentic operating system” that can be used without the company’s R1 hardware.

🧩 How it works

OS3 runs in the cloud but operates locally across Windows, Mac, and Linux devices. The system is designed to automatically determine the following components required to complete a task:

  • Devices
  • Files
  • Apps
  • AI models

⚙️ Key details

  • Account Capacity: Users can add up to five devices and their preferred AI models to one account.
  • Privacy: Rabbit claims OS3 will not store, copy, use, or sell user data, though it will keep chats and associated memories on its servers. Data handled by other linked AI providers is subject to those providers’ own privacy rules.

🚀 Availability

OS3 can be accessed through several methods:

  • A dedicated desktop site
  • Paired messaging apps such as iMessage or Telegram
  • The Rabbit R1 device

💡 Why it matters

Founder Jesse Lyu has informed Wired that Rabbit has stopped manufacturing R1 devices. However, the company is focusing on a new vibe-coding “cyberdeck” designed to run OS3, which is expected to launch within “months.”

#Rabbit #OS3 #AIagents #AIhardware

item.title: Apple Rolls Out Siri AI and New Software Updates Across Platforms
item.description:
Apple Rolls Out Siri AI and New Software Updates Across Platforms

Apple has begun rolling out Siri AI, the next generation of Apple Intelligence, alongside powerful parental controls and software improvements across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, and other Apple platforms.

🔍 Overview

Siri AI is an entirely new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence. It is deeply integrated into iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro, offering a more conversational assistant with broad world knowledge and personal context understanding.

⚙️ Key Details

Feature Capability
Siri AI Understands personal context across emails, messages, and photos; utilizes onscreen awareness and web access for up-to-date information.
Siri Mode Integrated into the iPhone Camera app to take action on things in front of the user, such as splitting bills via Apple Cash or adding Wallet passes.
Visual Intelligence Allows users on iPhone, iPad, and Mac to ask about screen content; Vision Pro users can ask about their surroundings.
Write with Siri Generates drafts or refines existing text based on user descriptions.
Siri App Uses iCloud to privately sync conversational history across all user products.
Image Playground Creates high-quality images in various styles, including photorealistic, with metadata and upcoming SynthID support.
Safari Tools Automatically organizes tabs into topics, notifies users of price drops or restocks, and enables custom extensions.
Call Context Surfaces reservation numbers or confirmation codes when calling a business.
Photos Tools Includes Spatial Reframing, Extend, and an upgraded Clean Up tool.

🛡️ Parental Controls

New intuitive features allow parents to manage digital experiences for children:

  • App Management: Parents can choose specific apps children access and add more over time.
  • Ask to Browse: Requires parental approval before children access new websites in Safari.
  • Communication Safety: Detects and blocks violent content or gore in shared images and videos; allows parents to approve new contacts.
  • Screen Time: Offers an at-a-glance view of average usage and top apps, with the ability to set daily time allowances for Social Media, Games, and Entertainment apps.
  • Schedules: Manages app access at different points of the day.
  • Setup Flow: A new process for child accounts to enable age-based safeguards across the system.

🚀 Availability

Siri AI is currently rolling out as a beta in English. Support for Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, and French is scheduled for October.

💡 Why it matters

The 2027 software releases introduce platform improvements in connectivity, search, and performance. Specific performance gains include:

  • Apps launch up to 30 percent faster on iPhone and iPad.
  • Photos load up to 70 percent faster after being taken on iPhone and iPad.
  • AirDrop transfers are up to 80 percent faster on iPhone and iPad.

#Apple #SiriAI #AppleIntelligence #iOS27 #ParentalControls

item.title: Proton-Autogen launches Windows executables on Linux without manual configuration
item.description:
Proton-Autogen launches Windows executables on Linux without manual configuration

Proton-Autogen is a new, lightweight Linux utility designed to streamline the execution of Windows applications by automatically managing Proton and Wine environments. It eliminates the need for manual Steam shortcut creation or complex prefix configuration, allowing users to run executables directly through their file manager.

🧩 How it works

Proton-Autogen functions as an orchestration layer that automates the setup of runtime environments. When a user selects a Windows .exe file, the tool detects available Proton installations and configures the environment to optimize compatibility. In cases where Proton cannot be used, the utility provides automatic Wine fallback support.

⚙️ Key details

  • Integration: Features native support for Nautilus (GNOME), Nemo (Cinnamon), and Dolphin (KDE Plasma) file managers.
  • Compatibility: Supports Proton-CachyOS, GE-Proton, and custom Proton builds.
  • Interface: Built with a GTK4 graphical interface, including advanced options and a CLI.
  • Diagnostics: Includes integrated tools to generate reports for troubleshooting via the proton-autogen --diag command.
  • Maintenance: Automatically handles prefix management and runtime detection.

🚀 Availability

The recommended installation method for Ubuntu-based systems is via the official PPA:

sudo add-apt-repository ppa:n3oray/proton-autogen sudo apt update sudo apt install proton-autogen

#Linux #Proton #Wine #Gaming #OpenSource

Source: N3oRay/proton-autogen
